title: fix: allow daily news generation without Buffer staging
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Add a `daily-generation-only` mode to restore a daily news archive without staging posts to Buffer.
- Keep the existing scheduled, daily, weekly, and monthly modes unchanged.
- Recover the September 7 archive after the failed image requests: summary, Twitter and Reddit JSON, and both JPEG images are now present on `news`.
- Validate YAML, shell syntax, mode selection and Buffer gating; verify the [successful recovery run](https://github.com/pollinations/pollinations/actions/runs/34282435760), saved dates, image links, and JPEG signatures. Biome does not process this YAML file.

gist.headline: News blooms without Buffer
gist.blurb: The daily news garden can now be replanted without sending anything through Buffer. September 7 is back on the archive shelf, with its summary, posts, and little JPEGs intact.
gist.summary: Added a daily-generation-only mode to the news workflow so a daily archive can be generated or recovered without staging posts to Buffer, restoring the September 7 summary, Twitter and Reddit JSON, and both JPEG images.
gist.impact: Readers regain the complete September 7 news archive, while maintainers can rerun daily news generation independently of Buffer staging.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy archive garden represents the recovered daily-news run: Polli, wearing a tiny librarian hat, carefully files a dated September 7 newspaper beside a retro terminal while two finished JPEG picture cards bloom from code-plants. A small closed Buffer-style delivery crate sits off to the side, showing that the archive can grow without staging a delivery; lime green folders, flowers, and warm shelves make the recovery feel complete.
